subject: Pilot alignment & next steps — scope, metrics, access
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@neptuneretail.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + proposed pilot scope

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap and a proposal for a tight pilot we can run to validate the recommendation and search improvements we discussed. I captured the items we agreed on and a suggested schedule so we can get engineering access and sample data lined up.

Pain points you emphasized:
- Search relevancy drops for seasonal SKUs and long-tail queries (poor recall).
- Homepage and product pages surface generic recommendations, not personalized.
- High latency for on-site recommendation API during promotions.

Pilot goals (success criteria):
- +10% lift in click-through on search results for targeted SKUs (A/B vs baseline).
- Reduce median inference latency for recommendation endpoint under load to <120ms.
- Show stable token-level cost projection for our recommended settings.

Proposed pilot scope (4 weeks):
1) Week 0: Access + baseline data pull (sample S3 export / 1 week of traffic)
2) Week 1: Model selection & prompt set prep (we will provide 20 prompt templates + examples)
3) Week 2: Integration and small-traffic A/B (5% of traffic) + monitoring
4) Week 3: Evaluation, metrics review, and go/no-go recommendation

Owners & asks:
- Jordan Blake (Redwood) — project lead, model selection, prompt set and evals
- Marissa Cole (Redwood CS) — integration support and rollout playbook
- Elena Morales (Neptune) — provide sample S3 exports, read-only DB credentials, and a small whitelisted test endpoint

Access checklist (what we need from Neptune to start):
- S3 path with product catalog + clickstream sample (CSV/JSON)
- A read-only user for Snowflake (or export) with product and catalog tables
- A low-traffic test API key or a staging host we can call for 1000 rps burst tests

Attachments: I attached a short pilot charter and a starter prompt set (see filenames below). If that looks good I can send an invite for a 30-min kickoff next week.

Attachments: neptune-poc-charter.xlsx (stub), sample-prompts.txt (stub)

Would Monday or Tuesday next week work for a kickoff? I can do Mon 9–11am PT or Tue 1–4pm PT.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Elena Morales <elena@neptuneretail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 18:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + proposed pilot scope

Thanks Jordan — this is great and captures the discussion. A few clarifications and confirmations: 

1) Data availability: we can provide a 2-week S3 export of catalog + session events by EOD Friday. Format will be JSON lines.
2) Snowflake: we prefer to grant a read-only role scoped to the schema; I have copied procurement for the access ticket.
3) Latency target: 120ms is acceptable for the pilot, but product ownership wants a plan for degradation on peak (we'll expect fallback behavior).

Kickoff: Monday 09:00 PT works for me. Please send calendar invite.

One ask — include a short list of prompts you plan to use for product recommendations so our ML lead can quickly review for safety/compliance.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Personalization | Neptune Retail
elena@neptuneretail.com
